topic: Data aggregation and Rail category removal
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on data discrepancies regarding the 'Rail' category. Initially, it was noted that the Rail category was missing from the staging dataset despite being present in the main ML table.

Later, a decision was made to remove the Rail dimension entirely from both the ML table and subsequent calculations, with the plan to re-aggregate the data on the staging environment.

The technical issues discussed included fixing the Rail implementation on the staging dashboard (staging-mops.allunite.com) and resolving repository push errors related to user permissions.
decisions: The 'Rail' dimension will be removed from the ML table and calculations.
Data will be re-aggregated on the staging environment without the Rail dimension.
